rewards: Access to Fairy Fixit's Fairy Enhancement Store.

st.t: Talk to Martin in the Draynor Market.
Wait 5 minutes.
Return to Martin in the Draynor Market.
s: I suppose I'd better go and see what the problem is then.

st.t: Wield your dramen or lunar staff and enter the shed door in the middle of Lumbridge Swamp to travel to Zanaris.
Search the healing certificate in Fairy Nuff's room, just north of the bank in Zanaris.
Long-press the certificate in your inventory and choose Study.
Read the sign near the Cosmic Temple in the south of Zanaris.
Talk to the Fairy Godfather in the Throne Room.
s: Where could she have been taken to?

st.t: Wield your dramen or lunar staff and go to the fairy ring west of the Throne Room, just south of the fountains.

While carrying Nuff's certificate, use the fairy ring to travel to A.I.R., then D.L.R., then D.J.Q., then A.J.S. Each time, long-press the ring and choose Configure to set the code: just tapping it may repeat your last trip. D.J.Q. won't take you anywhere: that's normal, so just set A.J.S. next.
st.tip: If you end up on an island with penguins, check you have Nuff's certificate and do all four codes again.

st.t: Follow the path from the fairy ring to the north-eastern room of the hideout and talk to Fairy Nuff.
Use the fairy ring near the hideout with code B.K.S. to return to Zanaris. Pickpocket the Fairy Godfather in the Throne Room while he and his henchmen are not looking.
While carrying Nuff's certificate, use the Fairy Rings to travel to A.I.R., D.L.R., D.J.Q. then A.J.S. Give Fairy Nuff the Queen's Secateurs, then talk to her again.
Travel to C.K.P with a Fairy Ring. Even if you've already made a magic essence (unf), you'll need to make another.
Wait for a star flower to appear.
Pick a star flower.
Travel to D.I.R. with a Fairy Ring, ready to kill a Gorak. Goraks can hit through protection prayers.
Kill Goraks for their claws.
Pickup the gorak's claws.
Add the star flower to a vial of water.
Use a pestle and mortar on the gorak claws.
Add the gorak claw powder on the unfinished potion.
While carrying Nuff's certificate, use the Fairy Rings to travel to A.I.R., D.L.R., D.J.Q. then A.J.S.
Use the magic essence on the fairy queen.
Talk to the Fairy Queen.
